description: This file defines a PHP class LeaveRequestModel within the OrangeHRM leave management plugin. It models a leave request data structure for API serialization, including properties such as ID, leave type details, and date applied. The class implements API serialization traits and constructs itself with specific entity and property filters.

classes.name: LeaveRequestModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing leave request data within the API, implementing normalization and filtering logic.
